name: Kuuhenki Shrine Key
description:
A key that can break the seal on the ancient Kuuhenki Shrines scattered around the Frost Moon.
These shrines that were built upon the moon's surface lost the benevolent being in whom faith was vested in ancient days as the will of the moon faded away. These secret keys found upon the frigid lunar soil can be used to break the seals — or perhaps they only use the fading voices of the past to help the shrines forget all that has come to ruin.
